figurative_meaning_en: To take aim or fix a target
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায়িক প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীকে তাক করে নতুন কৌশল গ্রহণ করা হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: The hunter took aim at the wild animal.
The business targeted the competitor with a new strategy.
note: Often used in contexts of precision or intention, reflecting everyday Bengali expression.
